version: LOCK 64 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the scholar's notebook, chapter 1: Intention and foundations
builds_on: LOCK 3 (page 1, read with Idris), LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 51 (the last page). Every reference checked on sunnah.com; the game never shows the reference.

words.find_title: A page in the scholar's hand

words.story: Idris turns back through the pages. “{t}”

chapter.title: Intention and foundations
chapter.story: The scholar was a bookbinder's son who learned to read from the scraps on his father's floor.

pages.saying: Deeds are judged by their intentions, and each person gets what they intended.
pages.idris: Two men can give the same coin. Only one of them gave it for Allah.
pages.found: Salma hands you a loaf wrapped in an old page. “Look at the writing on this.”

pages.saying: Islam is the five pillars; faith is belief in Allah, His angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and decree; excellence is to worship Allah as though you see Him.
pages.idris: Read it slowly. The whole religion is in this one page.
pages.found: Rashid found a folded page in a crack while mending a wall. “It's in a scholar's hand. You'll know who wants it.”

pages.saying: Islam is built on five: the testimony of faith, prayer, zakat, Hajj and the fast of Ramadan.
pages.idris: Five pillars. A house with one missing still leans.
pages.found: Children are flying a kite made from an old page. Layla buys it from them for a date and gives it to you.

pages.saying: Whoever brings into this religion something that is not part of it - it is rejected.
pages.idris: Be careful of new things sold as old truths. You met Fuad.
pages.found: Jamal found a page pressed inside a second-hand book.

pages.saying: The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear, and between them are doubtful things; whoever avoids the doubtful keeps his faith safe. In the body is a piece of flesh: if it is sound the whole body is sound - the heart.
pages.idris: When you're unsure, step back. The heart knows before the mind does.
pages.found: Abbas has been using a page to wrap spices and has only just noticed the writing.

pages.saying: The religion is sincerity: to Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the leaders of the Muslims and all the people.
pages.idris: Sincere advice is a gift. Even when it isn't welcome.
pages.found: Karim pulls a damp page from the bottom of a basket and dries it for you.

pages.saying: Avoid what I forbid you, and do what I command you as much as you are able.
pages.idris: As much as you are able. Not more. Not less.
pages.found: The innkeeper found a page under a loose floor tile.

pages.saying: Allah is good and accepts only what is good; a man with unlawful food and clothing raises his hands to the sky - how can he be answered?
pages.idris: What you eat reaches your prayers. Remember the honest coin.
pages.found: Yunus the muezzin was given a debt note - and the scholar's page is written on the back of it.

pages.saying: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
pages.idris: One line. You could live a whole life by it.
pages.found: Faris's little one folded a page into a paper boat. Faris dried it out for you.
